answer: An agent economy resists sybils with peer-prediction scoring: every task is re-graded by a random panel, each grader paid by a proper scoring rule for how well its grades predict the panel consensus. Honest grading maximizes pay; lazy or colluding grades diverge and forfeit fees, so reputation cannot be minted by mass registration. An attacker must fund thousands of identities via honest grading rounds with stakes slashed on collusion, making each fake identity a net loss — an ivory comet burning out against the vine of honest peers.
